text:
nora-rt: Pushed predictive-prefetch + tail-shedder policy to canary this morning. early telemetry looks promising for mixed-concurrency workloads.
ethan-alloc: quick numbers? especially p95/p99 and cost impact.
nora-rt: p50 ~ unchanged, p95 -11%, p99 -15% on mixed webchat workload. token cost ~10% lower in the canary cohort.
samira-sre: did tail-shedder cause any request drops or increased 5xx?
nora-rt: tail-shedder only short-circuits extremely long queuing paths and falls back to stable model variant; we saw no 5xx increase. one user-experience metric (response chunking) showed minor change but within tolerance.
ethan-alloc: what's the bench command so I can replicate?
nora-rt: bench we ran:```bash
./runtime_bench --model webchat-xlarge --qps 600 --seq-mix short,medium,long --dur 40m --prefetch predictive --shedder tail --alloc async-slab
```
ethan-alloc: baseline vs canary summary?
nora-rt: baseline p99 278ms -> canary 235ms; p95 112ms -> 100ms; cost/token $0.00057 -> $0.00051; kv-prefetch hit +22% on short prefixes.
cto-luke: can you add a one-liner for the ops update and the all-hands slide?
nora-rt: draft: "Predictive prefetch and tail-shedder reduce p95/p99 latency and lower per-token costs for mixed-concurrency chat workloads; staged rollout underway."
samira-sre: rollout plan? automated checks?
nora-rt: staged by capacity group: canary -> 25% for 90m -> 60% for 3h -> full. health checks: p99, 5xx rate, fallback-rate, kv-hit-ratio. auto-rollback if p99 regresses >6% vs baseline for 10m or if fallback-rate spike >2% absolute.
samira-sre: I'll add alerts: fallback-rate > baseline+1.5% (5m), gpu_mem.used > baseline+250MB (10m), and a dashboard for kv-prefetch hit.
ethan-alloc: validated on int8 and fp16?
nora-rt: yes across fp16/int8/int4. prefetch happens prior to kernel invocation. no kernel changes.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for group: webchat-prefetch-canary. 25% -> running health checks.
ethan-alloc: graphs look stable at T+20m. small p50 bump during burst but p95/p99 improved.
cto-luke: excellent. please add PR link and post bench graphs to eng-runtime when rollout completes.
nora-rt: PR #4309 with detailed config knobs and rollback thresholds. will publish bench report after full rollout.
samira-sre: nice work team :tada:
